title: Store underline as a source-bound text span
when: A question stem contains printed underline.
do: Retain start/end offsets or stable span IDs in text runs.
Serialize native character underline instead of encoding Korean prose as a math object.
check: The exact span is underlined, including repeated text cases and Korean offsets.
limitation: The candidate Daechi string-match implementation is narrower than a span-ID contract; repeated identical text needs explicit offsets.
